note: Total boundedness (equivalently, for this closed set, compactness) is checked numerically: with the bofop degree bound the greedy eps-net over sampled DIDMs saturates, while dropping the bound makes the net grow without saturating. A dense-graph DIDM concentrated above the bound sits at strictly positive mover's distance from every bofop DIDM, confirming the inclusion is proper. Finite-sample surrogate for a topological statement -- it is evidence, not a proof.
